page.nextBansLOSER: The team that lost the previous map bans first; on a draw, same order as on the previous map.
page.nextBansWINNER: The team that won the previous map bans first; on a draw, same order as on the previous map.
page.scaleHint: These maps apply to every match of the round: the map is no longer entered match by match. “Reset the round” brings back the per-match entry.
page.resetConfirmBody: This round's maps are removed for all its matches: the map is entered match by match again. Picks already made on matches stay.
page.tiebreakHint: Playoff round: one extra map, played only if both sides are one map away from winning (drawn maps included). Bans follow the next-maps rule.
page.refereeHostBan: The designated referee creates the game: the team that is not the top seed bans first.
